visualCharacteristics.purpose: Slider of vertical video shorts (customer stories, brand videos)
visualCharacteristics.summary: Slider of vertical (9:16) video shorts with poster, view count and optional Shop Now pill; coverflow or flat row
visualCharacteristics.layout: Vertical 9:16 posters, several per view, side arrows; clicking a poster plays the video in place (mp4/webm via <video>, YouTube/Vimeo via embed) and pauses others. Option coverflow centers the active short and scales its neighbours down

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: poster image; cell 2: link to the video (mp4/webm file, YouTube or Vimeo URL); optional text such as a view count, and an optional "Shop now" product link
contentPattern.source: 6 vertical video shorts (poster + video link) in a coverflow slider | 8 vertical video shorts, each poster + video + Shop Now link

usage: Short-form video showcases. Always provide a poster image so the page stays light; videos load only when played.
reuseGuidance: Use for vertical shorts. For a single landscape video use an embed/video block instead.
implementationNotes: Shares the carousel engine in /scripts/carousel.js (prev/next, indicators, keyboard arrows, ARIA, autoplay with pause control) and helpers in /scripts/block-utils.js.
